title: Measuring Form and Function in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.28616v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce quantitative metrics for child language acquisition to evaluate language models. Our focus is on the formal syntactic and functional discourse properties of determiners in English, which young children acquire early and accurately. We propose Contextual Alternative Choice (CAC), a new prompting method which provides targeted tests for both syntactic and discourse knowledge of language. The method enables direct comparison of language models against children, and more importantly, against statistical benchmarks independently established in empirical research. No current model trained on a comparable amount of data simultaneously meet both formal and functional benchmarks like human children, but some very large models do. We present our results as methodological and technical contributions, with specific emphasis on cognitive status of language models.

translated_title: 《测量语言模型中的形式与功能》
translated_abstract: 我们引入儿童语言习得的量化指标来评估语言模型。我们的研究重点是英语中限定词的形式句法属性和功能话语属性，这些是幼儿能够早期且准确地习得的。我们提出了情境替代选择（CAC），这是一种新的提示方法，可为语言的句法知识和话语知识提供针对性的测试。该方法使语言模型能够与儿童进行直接比较，更重要的是，可以与实证研究中独立建立的统计基准进行比较。目前没有任何在可比数据量上训练的模型能够像人类儿童那样同时满足形式和功能基准，但一些超大模型可以做到。我们将我们的结果作为方法论和技术贡献呈现，并特别强调语言模型的认知地位。
tldr: 本文提出基于儿童语言习得的量化指标和情境替代选择（CAC）提示方法，用于评估语言模型对句法与话语知识的掌握，发现现有同等数据量训练的模型无法像儿童一样同时满足形式和功能基准，但部分超大模型可以。
